description: Source code for the positioning measurement procedure in a 3GPP-related wireless communication system, including functions for mapping RSRP values, handling MAC measurement requests, and preparing F1AP responses.

classes.name: positioning_measurement_procedure
classes.description: Handles positioning measurement procedures, including request handling and response preparation.

methods.name: rsrp_dbfs_to_l3_rsrp_mapping
methods.description: Maps RSRP in dBFS to L3 RSRP value as per TS 38.133.

methods.name: positioning_measurement_procedure::operator()
methods.description: Main operator to execute the positioning measurement procedure.

methods.name: positioning_measurement_procedure::prepare_f1ap_response
methods.description: Prepares the F1AP response with measurement results.

methods.name: srs_config_matches
methods.description: Checks if two SRS configurations match.

methods.name: prepare_mac_cell_positioning_request
methods.description: Prepares MAC cell positioning request based on cell index and carrier.
